description: MUTATES the calendar (non-food events, tasks, sleep). Replies owed ('what to reply to X') go to create_pending_reply. Woke at X: end_time. Requires title + event_date (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, or YYYY; alias date). Soft dates preserve date_precision. Optional: event_time (alias time), end_date, end_time, location, description (alias notes), category, visibility, timezone, reminder fields, sharing/people, scoreboard (structured operating status; keep description for notes), and idempotency_key. Sleep with only a wake time ('I woke at 11:15'): category sleep, event_date the day they woke, end_time 11:15 and no event_time. Don't invent a bedtime; add it later with update_event event_time (a bedtime the night before also sets event_date to that night and end_date to the wake day). Timed events default to the profile push-reminder timing; all-day events stay off and explicit reminder_enabled=false opts out. Prefer log_travel for trips/residences. Unknown people do not fail the write. Public events return share_url. Requires API key or OAuth with context scope; share tokens cannot write. ($0.10; API key required)

amount.description: If set, also writes a /money transaction (dual-write). Prefer log_transaction / import_venmo_gmail for cashflow-first digs.

category.description: e.g. sleep, funeral, family, work, travel. Stored as events.category and event_type.

city.description: Structured city (composed into location if location omitted)

date_precision.description: Soft date precision stored in metadata. YYYY/YYYY-MM dates default to year/month.

description.description: Notes about the event. Alias: notes.

end_date.description: Optional end date YYYY-MM-DD (multi-day, or a night that ends the next day).

end_time.description: Optional end time (same formats as event_time). Works without event_time, e.g. a wake time alone.

event_date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, or YYYY (required). Alias: date.

event_time.description: Optional start time: 8pm, 20:00, or 20:00:00. Alias: time. Leave it out when nobody said it.

event_type.description: Optional event kind (e.g. todo, goal, work). Worked out from category when omitted.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client key (max 128 chars). Retries with the same key return the original result instead of creating a duplicate. If omitted, Dayze fingerprints args for ~15 minutes.

image_url.description: Optional cover image URL for Explore + /e share cards.

location.description: Free-text place. Or pass city + country.

mirror_transaction.description: Default true when amount is set; set false to keep calendar-only

people.description: People names or person UUIDs to tag (event_people role=with).

person_name.description: One person to tag, by name.

reminder_enabled.description: Timed events default to a push reminder when omitted. Set false only for an explicit opt-out; all-day events stay off.

reminder_minutes_before.description: Push lead time. Uses the profile reminder_timing when omitted (fallback 30 minutes).

request_id.description: Alias for idempotency_key (preferred by some clients).

scoreboard.description: Operating status as data (not description prose). state is required when the event has no scoreboard yet. On update_event fields merge; a null field clears it; scoreboard null removes the record.

share_with.description: Dayze profile handles to add as collaborators via shared_events (e.g. ["boof"]). Leading @ stripped.

source_gmail_id.description: Gmail message id the event came from (kept in metadata).

timezone.description: IANA timezone for wall-clock display (e.g. America/New_York).

visibility.description: Calendar visibility. public → appears on /explore and gets share_url https://dayze.com/e/{id}. Default private.

name: log_event

items.description: A Dayze person or contact record.
